title: The Valencia Marathon 2026 course — official route page
claims: The 2026 course starts at Plaça de la Marató and finishes on the blue carpet floating over the water at the City of Arts and Sciences.
The course page describes the route as flat and built for speed, running from the El Cabanyal neighbourhood through historic Valencia.
There are 9 refreshment points with Aquabona water (33 cl bottle) and Aquarius in cups, plus 3 Enervit red points offering energy gels with and without caffeine.
The organiser-linked Strava route records 42.5 km distance and 76 m elevation gain for the Maratón Valencia Trinidad Alfonso Zurich.
The course page publishes a static 2026 course map and a per-kilometre split-time PDF; no downloadable GPX, KML or GeoJSON track is linked there.
